<script>
(function () {
  // Tab switching
  document.querySelectorAll('.ach-tab').forEach(function (tab) {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ach-tab').forEach(function (t) {
        t.classList.remove('ach-tab--active');
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.ach-panel').forEach(function (p) {
        p.hidden = true;
      });
      this.classList.add('ach-tab--active');
      document.getElementById('tab-' + this.dataset.tab).hidden = false;
    });
  });

  // Filter pills
  function markLastRow(tbody) {
    var rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
    rows.forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove('ach-row--last'); });
    var visible = Array.from(rows).filter(function (r) { return !r.hidden; });
    if (visible.length > 0) {
      visible[visible.length - 1].classList.add('ach-row--last');
    }
  }

  var kubicleBody = document.querySelector('#tab-kubicle tbody');
  markLastRow(kubicleBody);
  markLastRow(document.querySelector('#tab-linkedin tbody'));

  document.querySelectorAll('.ach-filter').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('.ach-filter').forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('ach-filter--active');
      });
      this.classList.add('ach-filter--active');
      var filter = this.dataset.filter;
      kubicleBody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(function (row) {
        row.hidden = filter !== 'all' && row.dataset.subject !== filter;
      });
      markLastRow(kubicleBody);
    });
  });
}());
</script>
